project_type: Next.js 14 App Router monorepo (apps/web = frontend, services/* = Express microservices)
build_system: npm workspaces; web app uses Next.js 14.2.3 with next build. Run from apps/web: `npm run build`. No separate compilation step needed for the frontend.
test_framework: None in apps/web — verification is TypeScript compilation via `npm run build`.
verification_instructions: Run `cd apps/web && npm run build` from the workspace root. A zero-exit-code with no TypeScript errors is a passing verification. Check for TS errors in the output before calling a FEAT complete.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell; use `cd apps/web && npm run build` for verification. Do NOT restart dev server. Admin API route base: http://localhost:4000. API gateway injects x-user-role header automatically — frontend does NOT set it manually.
contribution_requirements: All new files are 'use client' where they use hooks. Follow the existing pattern: ProtectedRoute for auth guard (but admin layout uses its own role check). No test files required by the project.
key_patterns: 1) 'use client' at top of every component that uses hooks. 2) React Hook Form + zodResolver for all forms (see apps/web/src/app/auth/login/page.tsx and apps/web/src/app/profile/page.tsx). 3) apiClient from src/lib/api-client.ts for all HTTP calls. 4) useQuery/useMutation from @tanstack/react-query for data fetching. 5) Colors: primary orange #FF6B00, navy #1B2E6B, page bg #F5F7FA. 6) Existing UI kit: Input, Button (variants: primary/secondary/ghost/danger), Modal, LoadingSpinner, Badge, Pagination, EmptyState — all in src/components/ui/. 7) ITrip, IBooking, ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse types in src/types/index.ts. 8) user.role: 'user' | 'admin' from IUser. 9) formatCurrency, formatDate, cn utils in src/lib/utils.ts. 10) Lucide icons used throughout. 11) Array fields on ITrip (inclusions, exclusions, highlights, startDates) — join with newline for textarea display, split on save.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages. apps/web/src/components/ — shared UI components (ui/, layout/, auth/, admin/ to be created). apps/web/src/lib/ — apiClient, utils, admin-api to be created. apps/web/src/hooks/ — useTrips, useBookings, useNotifications. apps/web/src/types/index.ts — all shared TypeScript interfaces. apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx — useAuth hook.
